subject: Drop the now-historical `_form` suffix from ExprToCL's emitters (~30 subs)
description:
After #303's s390 chunk deleted the 24 pre-E2 TEXT emitters from Pl/ExprToCL.pm, the `*_form` suffix no longer distinguishes anything: for every node type except inline_lambda there is exactly ONE emitter and it produces a CLForm. The suffix is now noise that reads as if a second emitter existed.

SCOPE: rename gen_funcall_form -> gen_funcall, gen_methodcall_form -> gen_methodcall, … (~30 subs plus the private helpers _wrap_wantarray_ctx_form/_ctx_wrap_form/_slice_in_context_form/_gen_scalar_deref_base_form/_gen_backslash_multi_term_form/_cl_string_literal_form/convert_perl_string_form). NOT gen_inline_lambda_form — its text twin gen_inline_lambda is still live (it is the one form handler that declines), so that PAIR keeps both names until #153's FOLD or a widening of the form emitter kills the decline.

Also in scope: the per-sub comments still explain themselves against the deleted twin ("E2 form variant of gen_hash_access", "same shape/side effects as the text emitter"). The file-level note added in s390 points a reader at git history; a rename pass should rewrite those leads properly and drop the note.

BAR: pure rename — corpus-diff byte-identical + gate. Check callers outside ExprToCL.pm first (Parser.pm/Parser2.pm/ExprToCL2.pm reference some of these names in comments; gen_node_form/gen_leaf_form/gen_binary_op_form are called from other modules).

DO NOT bundle with a behaviour change. IR-neutral, so it can land any time; sequence it with the v0.1 track (#281) if that is cheaper.</description>
